This vignette illustrates a typical workflow in pharmaceutical data analysis using functions from **PharmaTestSuite**.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(PharmaTestSuite)
```

## Data Cleaning

Use the provided datasets to demonstrate cleaning steps.

## Statistical Analysis

Examples of t-tests, ANOVA, and logistic regression.

```{r bayes-example, eval=FALSE}
fit <- pharma_bayesian_glm(outcome ~ dose, data = pharma_sample, iter = 500, chains = 2)
pharma_posterior_summary(fit)
```

## Reporting

Summarize results and generate basic plots.
